dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, the mass production of the new clock model has been going smoothly, and the ores Ms. Puca has provided to us have been of high quality.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Actually, I was planning to make a new batch of clocks designed for Melusines based on this model.

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: Of course, we'll use a water-resistant clam-style structure — I'm sure this will be a market-opener!

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: The only problem we have is that Ms. Puca doesn't seem to want to use Mora as collateral for trade...

dialogues.speaker: Chesil
dialogues.text: I've been racking my brains as to the sort of things she'll take in exchange...
